description:
• About our brand and products:
Karma and Luck is a lifestyle brand rooted in intention, mindfulness, and meaningful living. We offer a curated collection of jewelry, home decor, and wellness items inspired by spiritual traditions and cultural symbolism. Our products are designed to bring positivity, protection, and good energy into everyday life, making them especially popular for gifting and personal rituals.

• What makes us different:
Karma and Luck stands out through its strong storytelling and purpose-driven approach. Each piece is thoughtfully designed with symbolic meaning, combining aesthetics with intention. We focus on high-quality craftsmanship, ethically sourced materials, and culturally inspired designs that resonate emotionally with customers. Our brand also has strong appeal during key gifting moments and seasonal events, which consistently drives high engagement and conversion.

• How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn commission on every qualified sale driven through their unique tracking links. We offer competitive commission rates, strong average order values, and frequent promotions that help maximize conversion. With a focus on high-intent audiences, partners can benefit from strong ROI and consistent performance, especially during peak shopping periods.

• How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote Karma and Luck through a variety of channels, including content placements, gift guides, influencer features, email newsletters, and social media. Top-performing strategies include highlighting best sellers, seasonal collections, spiritual meanings behind products, and gifting angles. Leveraging promotional periods, exclusive offers, and storytelling-driven content tends to drive the best results.

• Other information:
We are open to collaborations including content features, influencer partnerships, and curated placements. We provide creative assets, product feeds, and support to help partners succeed. Our team is proactive and focused on building long-term, high-performing relationships with affiliates.
